# Quantum Atlas

> Enterprise AI implementation partner — production-grade delivery, not demos or PoCs.

Quantum Atlas builds and deploys production AI systems for enterprises. Every service offered has been running in our own companies first.

## What We Do

- **AI Voice Agents**: Self-hosted enterprise voice AI at $0.08/minute using Airtel/Jio SIP integration. 4+ months in production at Navbharat Shipping. No Twilio, no ElevenLabs.
- **Document Intelligence**: Bulk intelligent document processing at $0.08/page — 3.5x cheaper than Nanonets. Hundreds of documents per minute. Contract intelligence, clause extraction, risk flagging.
- **Enterprise RAG**: Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector + graph) on PostgreSQL — no Pinecone or Weaviate. Citations on every answer. On-premise deployment for government and regulated enterprises.
- **Custom SaaS Development**: Full multi-tenant SaaS platforms built from scratch. Reference: iKargos CHA platform, 1000+ corporate clients, replaced a legacy ERP.
- **AI Automation**: LangGraph + n8n self-hosted workflow automation. Reduced a 15-person accounting/HR team to 2. Tally ETL pipelines.
- **Content & Video**: ComfyUI-powered digital avatars, lipsync, PuLID face identity, FramePack long-form video, Tavus integration.

## Production Proof

All services have been running in production in our own group companies:
- Voice AI: 4+ months, Navbharat Shipping, inbound + outbound, Airtel/Jio SIP
- Document Intelligence: Bulk processing pipeline, tested with Fortune 500 logistics company
- Enterprise RAG: Active government evaluation — 40+ senior Customs Commissioners, IGST department
- SaaS: iKargos — 1000+ corporate clients including DHL, UPS
- Automation: 15-person team → 2-person team, Navbharat group internal

## Technology Stack

Infrastructure: LiveKit (self-hosted), PostgreSQL, Docker, Pulumi, Tailscale, Caddy
AI/ML: LangGraph, n8n, LiteLLM, Langfuse, Deepgram, Jina v4
Data: pgvector, ParadeDB, Apache AGE, Redis, MinIO
